messages:
maria_g: Quick sync — we have an incoming SI + hardware partner listing for ACME Corp (cloud marketplace). Before we ok the listing, we need: lead ownership, account mapping, and a single HW partner contact. Who owns intake?
kevin_t: I can own intake if we agree rules. Is ACME already in our CRM? region?
alex_h: ACME is in CRM as a trial from last quarter, no committed ARR. Region: EMEA.
julien_p: Suggest gating rules: if ARR < $200k and trial-only -> partner-led intake (SI + HW). If > $200k or enterprise contract -> sales-led + partner support. Thoughts?
sophia_r: +1 to gating. Also we should decide co-sell credit split before intro. KAM needs to be looped for pipeline credit.
kevin_t: OK. For marketplace listing specifically, propose this mapping: [trial-only OR <200k] -> Partner Claim (SI primary, Redwood as co-sell) ; [>=200k OR on-contract] -> Redwood Claim (sales + partner enabled). I'll update intake table.
marketplace-bot: New listing form submitted: https://redwood.app/listings/ACME-2026 — metadata includes partner: Tugboat Systems, hw_vendor: EdgeComputeCo, sku: marketplace-device-XL.
maria_g: Good — Tugboat Systems is the SI. EdgeComputeCo is the hardware partner. julien, can you confirm the Tugboat rep contact & their named AE?
julien_p: I have Tugboat rep: @mark_tugboat (mark.t@tugboat.io). Their AE is Lina Park. I'll DM Mark now and confirm who will claim.
alex_h: To make onboarding smooth, draft a one-paragraph intro template we can send to ACME + Tugboat + EdgeComputeCo. Something like:
```
Hi <ACME> — intro: Tugboat Systems (SI) will lead the marketplace deployment with EdgeComputeCo hardware. Redwood will provide inference platform and co-sell support. Please confirm primary contact for procurement and pilot timeline.
```
maria_g: That works. Alex, add a line asking for procurement contact + expected pilot start.
sophia_r: I'll own co-sell credit conversation. Action: I'll propose a 70/30 split (SI/redwood) for this pilot, subject to KAM signoff.
kevin_t: Action items: 1) I will mark ACME as Partner-Claim in intake table (kevin_t) 2) Alex to draft intro email (alex_h) 3) Julien to confirm Tugboat contact + AE (julien_p) 4) Sophia to open KAM thread for credit (sophia_r) 5) Marketplace team to hold listing until claim confirmed (mktgops)
maria_g: Timeline: aim to have claim + intro ready by EOD tomorrow so we can approve listing on Monday. If Tugboat doesn't claim by then we fallback to Redwood-claim and notify KAM.
kevin_t: I'll update the mapping sheet now: https://docs.redwoodhq/internal/si-intake-mapping (editing).
alex_h: I'll post the intro in this thread once drafted.
julien_p: Mark replied — Tugboat will claim and Lina will join intro. He gave Lina's email: lina.park@tugboat.io.
sophia_r: KAM thread started: @olivia_kam is on notice. Will escalate if credit needs exec approval.
maria_g: Perfect. Thanks everyone. Closing loop once intro sent. :white_check_mark:
